What the record says

  • The Patriots' best spread spot with at least 30 graded games is favored by 3.5 to 6.5 (since 2002): 64-32-1 against the spread, a 66.7% cover rate.
  • Their weakest is underdog of 3.5 to 6.5 (since 2002): 16-19, 45.7%.
